officialSources.observation: Official West Bengal land-record portal lists Mouza Map Request, Mouza Map Availability Details, RS-LR plot information and plot-map request; citizen actions prompt sign-in.

Official state urban property procedure describes OTP registration and selection by district, block and mouza, then plot/khatian; it states linkage to Land & Land Reforms and Registration databases. No Dhulian-specific availability result was obtained.
Official state urban-development PDF includes a Dhuliyan Municipality map; it is an urban/administrative map, not parcel geometry.
Municipal site describes the local body and wards; it does not expose cadastral records or a parcel map.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: The official portal lists mouza and plot-map functions but directs users to sign in. The UD&MA property procedure requires OTP registration.
